high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a plain, dark background. The individual is wearing a white dress with long sleeves and a deep V-neckline that accentuates the décolletage. The dress appears to be form-fitting and short, ending above the knees. The person has long, wavy hair that cascades over their shoulders. On their head, they are wearing a Santa hat, which is red and white, adding a festive touch to the overall look. The person is smiling broadly, giving off a cheerful and joyful mood. Their hands are raised, adjusting the Santa hat, which adds a playful element to the pose.
